evidence.title: Google AI Releases Gemini 3.5 Transcribe: A Speech-to-Text Model Reporting 2.6% Average WER Across 85+ Languages

summary: Google AI introduced Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, a multilingual speech‑to‑text model that reports an average word error rate of 2.6% across more than 85 languages. The new offering expands the Gemini 3.5 suite, targeting high‑accuracy transcription for global users.
title: Google AI Launches Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, Achieving 2.6% Avg WER Across 85+ Languages
